reviews.text: We've already been on two courses, and both the dog and I had a great time! Oh, and of course, it's not to mention that we learned a lot and I got useful tips not only for teaching specific tasks, but also for everyday life with dogs. :)

We had a fantastic time during both courses we took. Every instructor we learned from was incredibly kind and we improved a lot through them. I can only recommend it, thank you for everything Daisy🐾🤗😍 …
I can highly recommend the dog school, the instructors are very kind and prepared. They also gave useful advice for our unique problem.
I highly recommend it to everyone! All the instructors are very friendly and they pay attention to every dog!
Great instructor. Opportunities for owners and dog children to learn. Small groups.
We did the puppy course and the dog daycare at this school. We are grateful for the help and expertise. We received immediate answers to all our questions. I can only recommend it.
